description:
MEASURED s493 (Fable, 2026-09-20).  Corpus: the Perl solutions of Rosetta Code (github acmeism/RosettaCodeData, sparse clone, 2,239 files), filtered STATICALLY to programs that touch no file, process, network, clock or chance (665 out), then admitted only if perl runs them to completion, deterministically, with output, in < 8 s: 655.  Everything is on disk: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/angles/rosetta/valid/NNNN-task.{pl,perl.out,pcl.out,pcl.err,pcl.rc}, selection script ../select.pl, runner ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/bin/diffrun.pl, log ../run-rosetta.log (main 093732ab, gen v2-1660).

BY FIRST COMPLAINT: 77 SILENT (output differs, rc 0, nothing on stderr); 19 statement dropped; 13 TIMEOUT at 60 s (perl < 8 s: look for #2098's quadratic shapes and BigInt speed); 11 regex code block `(?{...})` stripped (ruled non-support); 10 undefined sub (POSIX floor/ceil = #1997, Digest::SHA = XS); 18 rc 1/255 with no recognizable message; 3 binding-stack exhausted (#1929); Storable / Unicode::Normalize / Encode missing (XS); 2 refused; 26 distinct messages in all.
CAUSES ALREADY SEEN in the first 27 (do not re-derive): regex `\K` silently never matches (`s/.{71}\K /\n/gr`; cf. #2050, #1528); a `#!/usr/bin/perl -l` SHEBANG switch is ignored (#2097); `for <10 3>` glob-as-word-list dropped; Math::BigInt (`ack2(4,2) has 3 digits` where perl has 19,729).
METHOD (the op/ census rounds' rules apply): a COUNT is not a finding -- re-run each failure for its CAUSE; group by cause, ONE task per cause with the smallest reproducer probed vs perl; grep the task store, DECIDED and not-supported.md before filing (expect about a third to be known); the round's output is a cause table `program -> cause -> task`, checked in with the corpus subset that becomes part of the everyday instrument (#2099: programs are third-party text -- check Rosetta's licence (GFDL 1.2) before checking any in; otherwise keep the fetch + select scripts and the expectations only).
Bar for calling the round done: every one of the 77 silent programs has a cause; the loud ones at least a class.


=== USER RULING s494 (2026-09-21) ===
SCHEDULED (AskUserQuestion: "Rosetta census round" selected): one Opus round that narrows the 177 differing programs to CAUSES, the 77 SILENT ones first, clusters them and FILES them (<= 1 h fixes may ship under the filler rule).  Launches on a free slot; Fable writes the brief.

BRIEF (s494): ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s494/s494r/prompt.md (label s494r, IDs 2130-2189, gen v2-1860 only if a fix changes emission).  Launch AFTER at least one of s492b / s492c is merged where possible: #2004 (context leak into sprintf LIST args), #2005, #2001 and #1997 (POSIX floor/ceil) are expected to explain a large share of the 77 silent programs, and the round re-runs the corpus on its launch tree FIRST so those are not re-derived.  GFDL: nothing from the corpus is checked in; the recipe + the cause table are.
subject: ROSETTA CENSUS (one Opus round, not launched): 655 perl-validated pure-computation programs by other authors, 478 identical under PCL (73.0 %) -- 177 differ, and **77 of those are SILENT** (rc 0, no complaint, wrong output): narrow each to a CAUSE, the silent ones first
